title: Lienholder Credits to Principal and Contract Unwinds
content:
Kestrel Auto Finance is the lienholder on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, and refunds of financed products and unwinds reach the contract as credits to principal.

## Refunds of financed products

- Refunds of financed KestrelCare service contracts, GAP waivers and maintenance plans cancelled while the contract is active are paid to Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder and credited to principal, one credit per cancelled product.
- These credits never reduce the monthly payment and do not count as a payment toward the next due date.
- A refund of a product whose contract is already paid off goes to the borrower instead and is not credited here.

## Status condition

A principal credit is posted only on a contract whose status is active or unwound, as the contract record shows.

## Unwinds

When the financed vehicle is returned under the 7-day return, or the purchase is cancelled before handover after the contract was signed, the contract is unwound:

- a contract-unwind credit clears the remaining principal;
- any fees due are waived;
- any installments the borrower paid are refunded within the tier's unwind payment refund business days.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare service contract cancelled while the finance contract is active | refund credited to principal; the monthly payment is unchanged and the next due date does not move |
| Two products cancelled (a service contract and a maintenance plan) | two principal credits, one per product |
| Product cancelled after the finance contract was paid off | refund goes to the borrower; no credit to the contract |
| Vehicle returned under the 7-day return | contract unwound: principal cleared, fees waived, installments paid refunded |
